lifestage.quote: For adult cats aged from 1 year

health-feature.quote: Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and shiny coat

texts.about_this_item: Club 4 Paws Premium "With Salmon" complete dry food for adult cats aged from 1 year. 32/15 balanced formula (32% protein, 15% fat) for daily feeding, made with 100% quality animal protein. Omega 3 + Omega 6 support healthy skin and a shiny coat; vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements and amino acids; a mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant. INTEGRAMIX formula of dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn and bananas for overall pet health. No artificial flavours or colours.
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: dehydrated chicken protein 23 %, maize, maize gluten, barley, rice, salmon meal 4 %, poultry fat (preserved with tocopherols), hydrolyzed animal protein, salmon oil 1 %, minerals, linseed 0,53 %, sugar beet pulp, brewery yeast, banana* 0,23 %, tomatoes* 0,2 %, hawthorn* 0,065 %, ginger* 0,01 %. Analytical constituents: crude protein 32 %, crude fat 15 %, crude ash 6,5 %, crude fibre 2,1 %, calcium 1,1 %, phosphorus 0,9 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,6 %, omega-6 fatty acids 3,1 %. Metabolizable energy per 100 g: 1611 kJ (385 kcal).
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding guide by adult cat weight is printed on the pack (kibble only, or mixed with Club 4 Paws pouches). Always provide fresh drinking water.
